discussion.body: Act 10. Open world chapter: remnants. Hunt or spare Vortan if he lived. Track Velith if she lived or dive the wreck-isle if she vanished in the wipe. Invasion diaspora in Brass Lands / Breakwoods / Acromarsh: camps, brass cards championship, optional Ash-only boards if he lives. Side: bounty boards, remnant forts, political errands between the four empires. Killing or sparing remnants here feeds FEAT-037 variations. Still not the ending.
